items.title: Information Day 2026 | HKU Architecture
items.description: Key visuals and posters and on-site environmental graphics for Information Day 2026 of the Faculty of Architecture, the University of Hong Kong ? Information day is an annual event of the University welcoming prospectus students, staff and mentors to gather and share academic experiences through admission talks, workshops and campus tours The key visual is served as a prelude of the faculty rebranding to be launched in 2027, with a hint on the future prospect of architecture, real estate and urban planning industries, addressing a closer synergy with digitalisation, artificial intelligence utilisation, and cross-disciplinary education and learning. The multi-faceted identity accentuates the diversity and versatility of the faculty education spectrum ranging from architecture, landscape studies, urban studies, surveying to multidisciplinary design. Typeface in use ? Stack Sans Headline by Koto

items.title: The Lure of the Aria
items.description: For its fall digital issue, the Loyola Marimount University (LMU) Magazine invited readers to discover opera through a personal, playful guide written by David Davila. The article moves from beloved classics to bold contemporary works, and it dismantles the idea that opera is elitist or out of reach. Opera descends from the communal pleasure of telling stories through music, and it is for everyone. Working under the art direction of Pentagram Austin, I approached the illustrations from the same place: people. Opera is, at its core, a human art form, made of desire, jealousy, grief, humor, and defiance. Rather than depicting grand stages or spectacle, I looked for the intimate moments inside each story, the glance, the gesture, the expression that tells you what a character is feeling before they sing a note. The aim was to make newcomers feel they were being introduced to people they might already know, not to an institution. Client: LMU Magazine Text: David Davila Art Direction: P

items.title: WICKED TALES
items.description: WICKED TALES reimagines familiar fairy-tale characters through a stranger, sharper and more mischievous lens. Their iconic identities remain recognizable, while their personalities, costumes and signature objects are pushed in unexpected directions. A collection of classic tales, slightly misbehaved.

items.title: Liquid Heads
items.description: Liquid Heads is an ongoing series of heads within the cosmos of Liquid Characters. The main focus is to carry the principles of the Liquid Characters over from the whole body to the upper body, and especially to the head. They are inspired by industrial design, fashion and the idea of creating something between solid and gas.
